files.patch:
@@ -445,10 +445,11 @@ python3 -m dynamo.sglang \
 
 ### MI355X deployment measured with SemiAnalysis InferenceX
 
-TP8·EP8 with DFlash V2 on 8× MI355X, measured in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) at concurrency 1–64.
+DFlash V2 on MI355X, measured in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) at concurrency 1–40: TP8·EP8 with the AMD monokernels at low concurrency, TP4·EP4 with HiCache at high concurrency.
 
-- **Container image.** `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:muse-spark-open-1020`.
-- **HiCache.** At concurrency 16 and above, add the HiCache flags below. `--hicache-size` is the host tier in GB per rank, so 253 GB needs about 2 TB of host memory across the eight ranks.
+- **Container image.** `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:muse-spark-open-1027`.
+- **Monokernels.** At low concurrency, add the monokernel flags below.
+- **HiCache.** At high concurrency, add the TP4 HiCache flags below instead. `--hicache-size` is the host tier in GB per rank, so 310 GB needs about 1.24 TB of host memory across the four ranks.
 
 ```bash Command
 SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 \
@@ -479,9 +480,21 @@ python -m sglang.launch_server \
   --port 30000
 ```
 
-```bash HiCache (concurrency 16 and above)
+```bash Monokernels (low concurrency)
+  --monokernel-backend amd \
+  --max-running-requests 2 \
+  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 2 \
+  --prefill-decode-interval 64
+```
+
+```bash HiCache (high concurrency)
+  --tp-size 4 \
+  --ep-size 4 \
+  --max-running-requests 80 \
+  --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 \
+  --schedule-policy shortest-prefill-first \
   --enable-hierarchical-cache \
-  --hicache-size 253 \
+  --hicache-size 310 \
   --hicache-write-policy write_through \
   --hicache-io-backend kernel \
   --hicache-mem-layout page_first
